notes: ACCESS: direct curl_cffi impersonation (chrome124) returned 200 on every URL, no WAF resistance - same route the prior Home-Decor pass used. robots.txt checked: no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web directive. TREE: taken from two independent sources that agree - (a) the server-rendered 'In This Section' child-category block on each category page, walked recursively from https://www.amara.com/shop/furniture, and (b) https://www.amara.com/sitemap.xml -> sitemap-category-department.xml (204 category URLs, full site taxonomy). COUNTS: Amara runs a legacy .NET (Frasers-group) storefront that server-renders 'N products' into each category page's own HTML - method 1 (rendered listing header). Every single leaf was additionally exhausted: the page-size is 60 and every furniture leaf is far below it, so I counted the unique li-productid attributes on each rendered page and each one matched totalProducts exactly (1=1, 2=2, 2=2, 3=3, 1=1, 1=1, 1=1, 4=4, 1=1, 2=2). SANITY CHECKS: counts differ per category (15/8/4/3/2/1) so no site-wide constant; h1 of every fetched page matches the intended node; a second read of all 12 furniture URLs a few minutes later returned identical numbers (no drift); the union of the leaf product IDs is exactly the 15 products the parent /shop/furniture reports, and the parent total 15 was NOT derived by summing children. SIZE: this is a genuinely tiny furniture range, not a truncated read - the whole amara.com catalogue is 931 products (sitemap-product-1.xml) and the Furniture department is 15 of them. DEAD NODES: /shop/bedroom-furniture and /shop/storage-furniture are still linked from the Furniture page's own 'In This Section' block but both resolve to the SearchNoResults page (h1 'Sorry - we could not find any search results'); /shop/garden-furniture (linked from /shop/outdoors) is likewise dead; /shop/sofas and /shop/cabinets-sideboards (stale links in the Furniture page's descriptive copy) are dead too. All excluded as retired slugs, not emitted. OUTSIDE THE FURNITURE DEPARTMENT: checked every room department for furniture-typed children - Bedroom (children are Bedding, Dressing Table Accessories, Jewellery Boxes, Nightwear: no beds/wardrobes/nightstands), Bathroom (accessories, storage baskets, towel rails, toiletries: no vanity units), Outdoors (Garden Decor, Outdoor Dining, Outdoor Entertaining: pots, picnicware, throws, towels - Garden Furniture node is dead, so no outdoor furniture), Dining (barware/glassware/tableware only), Home Accessories > Storage (boxes, baskets, bins = standalone storage goods, excluded per the storage-vs-furniture line), Home Office Accessories (4 products, desk stationery, excluded). Title-scanned all 931 product URLs in the product sitemap for furniture keywords: the only furniture-typed products are the 15 already captured, plus one orphan 'Gallery Rauma Pouffe Nutmeg' product page that is not assigned to any live category listing. EXCLUDED per brief: lighting, mirrors, clocks, wall decor, vases/ornaments/frames, tableware/glassware/kitchenware, textiles (bedding, cushions, throws, rugs, curtains, towels), home fragrance, gifts, standalone storage boxes/baskets/bins, bathroom fixtures and accessories, coffee-table books, games, pet beds. NAVIGATION JUNK dropped: /shop/*-shop-all pages, /special/new/furniture, sale/outlet, gifts-by-* and Christmas edits.
